notes: Student start, income, moving out, conference and vanity-purchase numbers (doc 23 §3, §7, §D).

starting_cash_usd.source: doc 23 P0-6 placeholder, kept; consistent with 'has some savings' range for a diligent working student (≈, no single citable study)

part_time_income_usd_per_quarter.source: ≈ derived: US federal minimum wage was flat at $7.25/hr the whole window (US DOL); a realistic campus/retail job paid somewhat above minimum, ~$8-11/hr at ~15-18 hrs/week → roughly $500-800/month ≈ $1,500-2,400/quarter. Set below that range's midpoint to keep the early game tight, per doc 23 §9's 'decisions must matter' anchor

student_start.income_stops_at: move_out (doc 23 §8: 'the income stops ⚙ — you're now full-time on mining')

2010.source: iPropertyManagement.com 'Average Rent By Year', ~$895/mo national avg used as a 1-month-deposit proxy

moving_out.effect: ends household power and household cards; unlocks the garage tier; +1 Bandwidth (doc 23 §7)
moving_out.discount_note: National averages are used as-is; a real college town would likely run 10-20% below this, which is a reasonable place to tune down in sim if playtesting shows the sink is too punishing.
